summary: Spencer James Nelson, 20, died after being struck in the head by a falling rock on the Maroon Bells traverse and tumbling about 600 ft into the Bell Chord couloir; he was wearing a helmet
location: Maroon Bells traverse (~13,000 ft), Bell Chord couloir
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Aspen Volunteer Fire Department; Pitkin County Sheriff Office; US Forest Service; Flight for Life; Colorado National Guard Blackhawk
notes: Date = Saturday Aug 14, 2010 (Denver Post account quoted in thread; recovery resumed Sunday; some sources list Aug 16 as date of death). Victim was with a party of 8 including his father; two off-duty Mountain Rescue Aspen members found him. | 2026-09-15: 14ers.com link removed per site ban; row retains other verified source(s).
